## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List the exact tests, benchmarks, or manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files or credentials.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests and relevant documentation.
- [ ] Model, performance, or certification claims link exact versioned evidence.
- [ ] Public API, package, artifact-format, or compatibility changes have a design issue.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] I have the right to submit all code, data, and documentation in this pull request.
